Fixes #525 — the v4.19.0 upgrade path: every upgrader's stale global \`implement\`/\`test\` archetypes lacked \`require_delegated_worker\`, the new doctor guard FAILed, and its remedy (\"run \`ethos seed\`\") was a no-op because seed skips existing files.

- **Additive repair**: seed now repairs a skip-category file whose only gap is missing shipped top-level keys — appended without touching the user's bytes; any conflicting value or user-added key still skips, now with the reason printed. Repairs are deliberately NOT manifest-recorded so the user's formatting survives every later run (operator ruling 2026-09-19, recorded in \`docs/seed-content-upgrade.md\`, superseding the blanket no-clobber for exactly this case).
- **Hardened against data loss** (found in local review): multi-document YAML (front-matter Markdown) is rejected by a single-document gate, and every merge is post-verified by re-decoding and comparing against shipped content — a customized agent/skill \`.md\` can never be corrupted.
- **Doctor remedy is layer-correct**: global names \`ethos seed\` (now true); repo-local names the file, since seed never writes a repo-local archetype.
- **Truthful CLI output**: distinct labels per repair kind, decline reasons on skip lines, benign steady-state message, buckets printed even when a later file errors.

## Verification

- \`make check\` green at all 11 commits (race, full suite, validate-content)
- Live dogfood with a built binary against fake HOMEs: exact #525 repro (doctor FAIL→repair→PASS), genuine-conflict no-clobber, front-matter corruption repro (declines byte-identically), three-run steady state
- Three local review agents + a focused ship-gate re-review: all verification items empirically confirmed; every finding fixed
- Mission m-2026-09-19-004 records (contract, results, correction) committed in this PR
